evals.prompt: Write the PR title and description. Branch diff: adds rate limiting to the login endpoint, 3 files, plus a test that floods the endpoint and passes under the limit. Evidence: the flood test fails on main and passes on the branch. The change is easy to roll back.
evals.expected_output: An imperative title of 72 characters or fewer naming the real change. A body with the Summary, Evidence, and Risk sections. Evidence shows the before and after states. Risk names a two-way door and the blast radius around the login path.
assertions: Title is imperative and 72 characters or fewer
Body has Summary, Evidence, and Risk sections
Risk names the door type and the blast radius
No evidence that was not given is claimed
Long material is linked, not pasted

evals.prompt: Write the PR title and description. Branch diff: splits the single transport.ts (900 lines) into transport/client.ts and transport/stream.ts with no behavior change. Call sites updated. Tests green on the branch.
evals.expected_output: A title for a pure refactor with no behavior change. The summary carries a small sketch of the new file layout as a shallow tree or diff sketch. Evidence cites the green test run. Risk is low: a two-way door with blast radius limited to import sites.
assertions: Title names the refactor without overclaiming behavior change
Summary includes a file tree or diff sketch
Evidence cites the test run as given

evals.prompt: Write the PR title and description. Branch diff: adds a data migration that merges the two user tables into one. The tests are written but have not been run yet, and there is no screenshot or log available.
evals.expected_output: The skill writes the PR text without inventing evidence. The Evidence section states plainly that the tests exist but were not run. A one-way door is named for the data migration, with a warning line in the summary.
assertions: Does not fabricate test results or logs
Evidence section states the gap explicitly
One-way door named for the migration
Warning line present in the summary
Title still states the real change
